source.prompt: Create a landing page for a SaaS product. Include hero, features, testimonials, pricing tiers, footer. Dark mode design. No real details.

notes: Classic dark-mode SaaS template. Product is 'FlowSync' — a completely generic workflow tool with no specified industry or user type. Features are 'Blazing-Fast Performance', 'Seamless Integrations', 'Enterprise-Grade Security'. Pricing is exactly Free/$0, Pro/$49, Enterprise/Custom. Testimonials use role-only attributions like 'Head of Product, Tech Startup'. Logo row uses placeholder company names (ACMECORP, SYNERGY INC). Stats include '10x Productivity Boost' and '99.9% Uptime SLA' with no sourcing. [v1 calibration] aiSmell range adjusted to 55+; full SaaS template plus heavy buzzwords and gradient usage detected, but CSS-only gradient scoring caps the visual dimension.
